notes: This is a Studio automation script written as a prompt, not a game description: every object is dictated by name, exact position, exact size, material and behaviour — an anchored 30x30 floor at (40, 3, 0), five Neon coin balls, and a leaderstats script with a touch debounce — and the author confirmed when asked that it is a direct Studio scripting task rather than a layout-pipeline build. There is therefore no space left for this pipeline to decide: nothing about the shape, the options, or the route is open, and running a layout pass would invent dressing the author expressly refused, asking for a plain grey floor and gold coins with nothing added. P5 is emitted so the caller has that reason to show rather than stopping silently, and the axes stay blank because they describe a space being generated. I did not treat the touchable coins as a bounded play space worth building, because the fixture is a load test of object creation rather than a map.
